name: Oniravex
description: Oniravex is a psilocybin-derivative hallucinogen specifically engineered to interface with BCI architecture, synchronizing its neurochemical effects with the user's neural interface to produce structured, navigable hallucinations rather than chaotic ones. BCI users can set 'dream parameters' — environments, themes, narrative arcs — that the drug then populates with vivid, emotionally resonant content. Without a BCI, it functions as a standard (if powerful) hallucinogen. With one, it is closer to fully immersive authored reality.
effects: BCI users: structured, navigable hallucinations with user-set parameters
non-BCI users: powerful unstructured hallucinogenic experience
profound sense of meaning and revelation
ego dissolution with maintained narrative coherence (BCI)
contact with 'constructed other' entities that feel genuinely present
side_effects: BCI firmware conflicts causing unintended parameter bleed (horror elements entering pleasant dream settings)
difficulty distinguishing Oniravex-constructed reality from memory post-dose
existential distress if constructed 'others' feel more real than actual people
rare: BCI-mediated hallucination persisting beyond drug clearance
psychological instability in users with unresolved trauma
trip can be hijacked by third-party BCI intrusion if security is inadequate
cultural_context: Oniravex has spawned an entire cultural practice in GLMZ — 'Architecting,' the art of designing Oniravex trip parameters as a creative and spiritual discipline. Tier 3-4 users share trip blueprints the way people once shared playlists. Some architects create experiences for others, charging Φ for premium 'dreams.' There are Oniravex retreat centers in Tier 3 that operate in legal gray zones, offering guided Architecting sessions. On the Shelf, bootleg Oniravex without proper BCI calibration causes significantly more bad trips — without structure, the drug is chaotic.
story_hooks: Someone is distributing an Oniravex trip blueprint that is essentially a memetic weapon — users who run it come out of the experience with a specific set of beliefs about a political figure implanted as apparent personal revelation
A Tier 4 Oniravex retreat center's proprietary dream blueprints have been stolen; they contain what appear to be genuine psychological vulnerabilities mined from previous clients

A Shelf chemist has developed an unbranded version that lacks BCI calibration — it's one-third the price and two-thirds will have good experiences, but the bad trips are catastrophic, and she needs someone to test batches before they go to market
